newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 14,300 slaughter steers and 12,300 heifers; 56,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,000 head formulated and 900 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 64.00. Select, few Choice 1050-1150 lbs 63.50-63.75.
Wk to Date - 56,300 Week Ago - 87,400 Year Ago - 48,100
